issues.description: Duplicate db.sh: same path added as both a regular file and a symlink to TEMPLATE
issues.detail: The diff adds egs2/tal_zh_adult_teach/asr1/db.sh twice: once as a regular file with TAL_ZH_ADULT_TEACH=downloads and once as a symlink to ../../TEMPLATE/asr1/db.sh. Two files cannot occupy the same path. Delete the standalone file and rely on the TEMPLATE symlink, editing the global db.sh instead.

issues.description: download_and_untar.sh violates its name's contract and silently continues when unzip is missing
issues.detail: The script never actually downloads (only extracts) and the `command -v unzip` check prints a warning without exiting, so execution proceeds and dies later with a confusing unzip error. Either rename to extract.sh and honor the supertype contract, or exit non-zero when unzip is missing or archives are absent.

issues.description: README ASR config link points to nonexistent ./conf/train/ path
issues.detail: README links the ASR config as ./conf/train/train_asr_branchformer_e24_amp.yaml, but the file actually lives at ./conf/train_asr_branchformer_e24_amp.yaml. The link 404s and misdocuments the recipe's externally visible spec. Fix the path to match the actual layout.

issues.description: local/data.sh parses --downloads_dir but never forwards it to download_and_untar.sh
issues.detail: The script declares `downloads_dir=` and runs parse_options.sh, then calls download_and_untar.sh with an empty/unset second argument. The advertised --downloads_dir option silently does nothing and may error under set -u. Forward the value or remove the option.

issues.description: run.sh sets use_lm=false but README documents LM decoding results as reproducible
issues.detail: run.sh disables the LM (use_lm=false), yet README advertises decode_asr_branchformer_lm_... rows as the recipe's results. Users running run.sh as-is cannot reproduce the documented numbers. Either default use_lm=true or document the override required to reproduce LM results.

issues.description: Usage block prints without exiting and uses unquoted $1 under set -euo pipefail
issues.detail: When argc is out of range the script cats usage but doesn't exit, so execution continues into `extract_dir=$(realpath $1)` with an unset positional. Combined with unquoted command substitutions, paths with spaces will explode. Add `exit 1` after usage and quote: `realpath "$1"`, `realpath "${2:-$extract_dir}"`.

synthesis.summary: The recipe is largely conformant ESPnet boilerplate, but several contracts are quietly violated. One hard structural bug: db.sh is added as both a real file and a TEMPLATE symlink at the same path. The download script is sloppy under set -euo pipefail (no exit on missing unzip, unquoted args, falls through usage), and its name lies about what it does. The README links a nonexistent conf/train/ path, data.sh parses --downloads_dir but never forwards it, and run.sh disables the LM that README claims as a result. Fixes are small and obvious — NEEDS-WORK.
